sph_interpretive_translation: That which is to be divided or allocated must be done so through yukti; otherwise, it becomes purposeless and leads to disorder.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from yukti-based allocation, not arbitrary assignment
Causation is determined by intelligent distribution aligned with dharma
Capacity-based responsibility arises only when division aligns with yukti
Restoration logic requires re-aligning divisions with ontological order
Consciousness alignment occurs when all allocations reflect yukti
executable_legal_axioms: IF a resource or right is distributed without yukti, THEN that distribution is null in dharmic law
IF an individual assumes authority over undistributed or misallocated entities, THEN their capacity is unmanifest and legally void
IF allocation does not follow yukti, THEN automatic reallocation protocols shall activate to restore alignment
IF dispute arises from misdivision, THEN resolution must invoke yukti-based redistribution, not punitive measures
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any claim of ownership, jurisdiction, or entitlement lacking yukti-based foundation is dismissed ex officio. The Court must ensure all legal distributions reflect yukti-derived integrity and reject claims rooted in arbitrariness or ignorance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that yukti is the valid means of division. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that improper division disrupts sequential harmony. Responsibility lies in restoring correct alignment, not inflicting consequence. Truth is restored through reallocation guided by yukti, not through punitive correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Reassess and redistribute according to yukti
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Require involved parties to affirm alignment with yukti before reintegration
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reinstate lawful capacity only upon verification of yukti-compliant action
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Ensure all affected domains realign with the original dharmic structure
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Dharma. This verse executes as law: division without yukti is void. Justice restores alignment. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
